production_safety.operational_data: Read existing local research documents only. No operational database, account, customer record or original research file was created, modified or deleted. Test notes were written only to isolated browser contexts. Generated corpus stays local and is Git-ignored.
production_safety.schema_migration: none: no database or backfill; browser state uses a versioned key.
external_side_effects: Installed npm packages and read official framework documentation.
Browser may fetch Google Fonts with system-font fallback.
Started local Next server on 127.0.0.1:3107; no external deployment, messaging or publishing.

verification.evidence: Production build succeeded; 57 static pages, 40 original documents and 8 lessons generated.
Strict TypeScript validation completed without errors; final production build also typechecked.
2 tests passed, comparing all 40 original bodies against source disk files and validating all eight lesson excerpts.
4 Chromium browser flows passed, including reload persistence, quiz reset, price tilde preservation, Korean search, mobile table scrolling, storage corruption recovery and 404 status.
Checked dashboard and document layout. Single-tilde prices were corrected after visual review and covered by browser regression assertion.

residual_risks: Local-only site; phone or remote Discord client cannot use the loopback URL. No hosting was deployed.
Source corpus contains client work; external deployment requires deciding which documents can be public.
Progress and notes are local to one browser origin and can be lost if its storage is cleared; no account sync or backup yet.
Source factual claims are preserved with correction-document links, not newly independently verified.
Source folder is a build prerequisite and must be re-imported after edits. Existing attachment files are not hosted.
